sections.Profile:
The "Big Ben" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in May 1954, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1954
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Landmark, Single Player, Travel, Wood Rail, Original Theme
